taxonomy_summary: Dinoplatypus flectus (Niijima & Murayama, 1931). Source-specific taxonomic history and uncertainties follow.

taxonomic_history.name: Platypus lepidus flectus
taxonomic_history.note: Replacement flectus Murayama 1931:197 verified; 1925 formosanus homonymy, unnecessary Schedl 1941 murayamaensis, Beaver & Shih 2003 combination and Beaver 2013 triplurus synonymy verified; uncertain Psidium guaiacum excluded.
